import base64,csv,hashlib,io,json,tarfile,urllib.request,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('.pytest_cache/native-source-analysis')
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def get(url):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=30) as response:
        return response.read()
metadata=json.loads(get('https://pypi.org/pypi/pydantic_core/2.46.4/json'))
chosen=[u for u in metadata['urls'] if u['packagetype']=='sdist' or u['filename'].endswith('cp314-cp314-win_amd64.whl')]
assert len(chosen)==2
report={'sourceUrl':metadata['info']['project_urls'].get('Source'),'artifacts':[]}
local=Path('.venv/Lib/site-packages/pydantic_core/_pydantic_core.cp314-win_amd64.pyd')
local_sha=hashlib.sha256(local.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
report['installedBinarySha256']=local_sha
for u in chosen:
    blob=get(u['url'])
    sha=hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()
    assert sha==u['digests']['sha256']
    (out/u['filename']).write_bytes(blob)
    item={'filename':u['filename'],'url':u['url'],'sha256':sha,'pypiDigestMatches':True}
    if u['packagetype']=='bdist_wheel':
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(blob)) as z:
            member=next(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.pyd'))
            item['wheelBinarySha256']=hashlib.sha256(z.read(member)).hexdigest()
            item['installedBinaryMatches']=item['wheelBinarySha256']==local_sha
            for label in ('WHEEL','METADATA','RECORD'):
                name=next(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.dist-info/'+label))
                item[label+'Sha256']=hashlib.sha256(z.read(name)).hexdigest()
    else:
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(blob),mode='r:gz') as t:
            names=t.getnames()
            item['rustSourceCount']=sum(n.endswith('.rs') for n in names)
            wanted=['Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','pyproject.toml','src/lib.rs','src/errors/validation_exception.rs','src/errors/line_error.rs','src/input/input_json.rs','src/validators/list.rs','src/validators/tuple.rs','src/validators/function.rs','src/input/return_enums.rs']
            item['sourceFiles']={}
            for rel in wanted:
                matches=[n for n in names if n.endswith('/'+rel)]
                if len(matches)==1:
                    data=t.extractfile(matches[0]).read()
                    dest=out/'source'/rel
                    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
                    dest.write_bytes(data)
                    item['sourceFiles'][rel]=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    provenance='https://pypi.org/integrity/pydantic_core/2.46.4/'+u['filename']+'/provenance'
    try:
        data=get(provenance)
        (out/(u['filename']+'.provenance.json')).write_bytes(data)
        item['provenance']=json.loads(data)
    except Exception as e:
        item['provenanceError']=str(e)
    report['artifacts'].append(item)
(out/'provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

"""Read frozen synthetic input; measure traced error ownership, not native bounds."""
import gc
import hashlib
import json
import sys
import traceback
import tracemalloc
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from scripts.experiments.c_benchmark import CODES, rows_from
from scripts.experiments.fused_c_validator import latest
from trade_plan_monitor.state.projections import _latest_index_records

path = Path('.pytest_cache/cna-measurements/dense.sqlite3')
before = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
rows = rows_from(path)
assert len(rows) == 1
payload = list(rows[0].payload)
payload[9] = payload[9].replace(b'"high_points":"1.', b'"high_points":"0.')
assert payload[9] != rows[0].payload[9]
row = replace(rows[0], payload=tuple(payload))
del rows, payload

def chain_summary(root):
    todo, visited, result = [root], set(), []
    while todo:
        error = todo.pop()
        if id(error) in visited:
            continue
        visited.add(id(error))
        result.append(dict(type=type(error).__name__, errorCount=error.error_count() if hasattr(error, 'error_count') else None, hasCause=error.__cause__ is not None, hasContext=error.__context__ is not None))
        for related in (error.__cause__, error.__context__):
            if related is not None:
                todo.append(related)
    return result

def clear_frames(root):
    todo, visited = [root], set()
    while todo:
        error = todo.pop()
        if id(error) in visited:
            continue
        visited.add(id(error))
        for related in (error.__cause__, error.__context__):
            if related is not None:
                todo.append(related)
        if error.__traceback__:
            traceback.clear_frames(error.__traceback__)
            error.__traceback__ = None

def measure(name, verify):
    gc.collect()
    tracemalloc.start()
    held = None
    try:
        verify(iter((row,)), CODES)
    except Exception as error:
        held = error
    assert held is not None
    live, peak = tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()
    chain = chain_summary(held)
    gc.collect()
    after_gc = tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()[0]
    clear_frames(held)
    gc.collect()
    after_frames = tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()[0]
    held = None
    gc.collect()
    after_release = tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()[0]
    tracemalloc.stop()
    return dict(variant=name, live=live, peak=peak, afterGc=after_gc, afterOuterChainFramesCleared=after_frames, afterRelease=after_release, chain=chain)

report = dict(inputSha256=before, rawBytes=len(row.payload[9]), measurements=[])
for name, verify in [('original', _latest_index_records), ('fused', latest)]:
    report['measurements'].append(measure(name, verify))
    print(json.dumps(report['measurements'][-1]), flush=True)
assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == before
report['sourceSha256'] = hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
report['limits'] = 'One pass per variant; prebuilt input excluded; no native transient/absolute-process certification. Diagnostic frame clearing is not a proposed production patch.'
Path('.pytest_cache/native-source-analysis/error-lifetime.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
